title: "Language in schools"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-13"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
require(readtext)
require(dplyr)
require(ggplot2)
require(forcats)
require(tidyr)
require(ggridges)
```

```{r}
language_2025 <- read.csv("Education/Raw data/institutii_2025_fixed.csv")
language_2020 <- read.csv("Education/Raw data/institutii_2020_fixed.csv")
```

```{r}
language_2025$year <- "2025"
language_2020$year <- "2020"
```

```{r}
language <- language_2020

language <- language %>% 
  rbind(language_2025)
```

```{r}

language$Language <- fct_collapse(language$Limba, 
                                  Romanian = c("Română"),
                                  Russian = c("Rusă"),
                                  Bilingual_Romanian_Russian = c("Română, Rusă"),
                                  Bilingual_Other = c("Bulgara, Rusă","Alta, Română", "Alta, Română, Rusă", "Alta, Rusă", "Bulgara, Rusă", "Engleză, Română, Rusă", "Franceză, Română", "Rusă, Ucraineana"))
```

```{r}
language$Type <- fct_collapse(language$Tip,
  Middle_School = c("Gimnaziu"),
  High_School = c("Liceu"),
  Primary_School = c("Şcoală primară", "Școală primară-grădiniță"),
  Combined_institutions = c("Gimnaziu-grădiniță", "Liceu – grădiniță"),
  Special_education = c("Auxiliară", 
                         "Pentru copii cu afecţiuni neuromotorii",
                         "Pentru copii orbi şi slab văzători",
                         "Pentru copii surzi şi hipoacuzici"))
```

```{r}
language_counts <- language %>% 
  count(year, Language, Type) %>%
  group_by(year, Type) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

language_counts %>%
  filter(Language == "Russian") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pct, fill = year, group = year)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~Type)
  labs(y = "Percent of Schools", color = "Language") +
  theme_minimal()
  
language_counts %>%
  filter(Language == "Bilingual_Romanian_Russian") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pct, fill = year, group = year)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~Type)
  labs(y = "Percent of Schools", color = "Language") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
language_counts_region <- language %>% 
  count(year, Language, Raion, Type) %>%
  group_by(year, Raion, Type) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

language_counts_region %>%
  filter(Language == "Russian") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pct, fill = Type, group = Type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~Raion)
  labs(y = "Percent of Schools", color = "Language") +
  theme_minimal()
  
language_counts_region %>%
  filter(Language == "Bilingual_Romanian_Russian") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pct, fill = Type, group = Type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~Raion)
  labs(y = "Percent of Schools", color = "Language") +
  theme_minimal()
```
